description: NaLi₅Fe₂P₂(CO₇)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.91 Å. There are five inequivalent Li sites. In the first Li site, Li is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 1.97-2.45 Å. In the second Li site, Li is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.44 Å. In the third Li site, Li is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra, corners with three PO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one FeO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 64-90°. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.43 Å. In the fourth Li site, Li is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra, corners with three PO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one FeO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 65-90°. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.06-2.51 Å. In the fifth Li site, Li is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra, corners with three PO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 65-86°. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.43 Å. There are two inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one LiO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.05-2.35 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.06-2.37 Å. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. All C-O bond lengths are 1.30 Å. In the second C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.30 Å) and one longer (1.31 Å) C-O bond length. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four FeO₆ octahedra and corners with five LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-64°. There is one shorter (1.55 Å) and three longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four FeO₆ octahedra and corners with four LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-60°. There is one shorter (1.54 Å) and three longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are fourteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three Li and one C atom to form OLi₃C tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent OLi₃FeC trigonal bipyramids, corners with four OLi₂FeP trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one OLi₂FeP tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one OLi₃FeC trigonal bipyramid. In the second O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Li, and one C atom to form distorted ONaLi₂C tetrahedra that share corners with two OLi₂FeP trigonal pyramids and  an edgeedge with one ONaLiFeP tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, one Fe, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Li, one Fe, and one C atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to three Li, one Fe, and one C atom to form distorted OLi₃FeC trigonal bipyramids that share corners with five OLi₂FeP tetrahedra, corners with three OLi₂FeP trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one OLi₃C tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one OLi₂FeP trigonal pyramid. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, one Fe, and one C atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to two Li, one Fe, and one P atom to form distorted OLi₂FeP trigonal pyramids that share corners with five OLi₂FeP tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent OLi₃FeC trigonal bipyramids, and  a cornercorner with one OLi₂FeP trigonal pyramid. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, one Fe, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to two Li, one Fe, and one P atom to form distorted OLi₂FeP trigonal pyramids that share corners with five OLi₂FeP tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one OLi₃FeC trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one OLi₂FeP trigonal pyramid. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Li, one Fe, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded to two Li, one Fe, and one P atom to form OLi₂FeP tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent OLi₃FeC trigonal bipyramids, corners with six OLi₂FeP trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one OLi₃C tetrahedra. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded to two Li, one Fe, and one P atom to form distorted OLi₂FeP trigonal pyramids that share corners with six OLi₂FeP tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one OLi₂FeP trigonal pyramid,  an edgeedge with one OLi₃FeC trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one OLi₂FeP trigonal pyramid. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Li, one Fe, and one P atom to form distorted ONaLiFeP tetrahedra that share corners with four OLi₂FeP trigonal pyramids and  an edgeedge with one ONaLi₂C tetrahedra. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, one Fe, and one P atom.
